# Summary

Sample: **`r params$sample`**

Sequencing depth treshold: **`r params$threshold`**

Reference sequence: **`r params$reference`**

**Detected Mutations**
```{r}
#Load Packages
pacman::p_load(ggcoverage, cowplot, tidyverse, GenomicAlignments, gt, knitr, rmarkdown)

```



```{r}
#Load data
resis_output <- params$resistance
all_muts_file <- params$formatted
bam_file <- params$bam
bed_file <- params$mut_bed

```



```{r}

resis_df <- read_tsv(resis_output)
#Are there any mutations?
if(nrow(resis_df)==0){
  cat("No characterised resistance mutations were detected.")
} else {
  summary_table <- resis_df |> mutate(across(ends_with("EC50_ratio"), as.numeric)) |> pivot_longer(cols = ends_with("EC50_ratio"), names_to="Drug", values_to="EC50") |> mutate(Drug = str_remove(Drug,"_EC50_ratio"))

  summary_table <- summary_table |> group_by(Gene, Mutation, Drug) |> summarise(Mean_EC50 = mean(EC50, na.rm=TRUE), Publications = n(), .groups="drop")

  summary_table <- summary_table |> mutate(Resistance = case_when(Mean_EC50 <2 ~ "Susceptible", Mean_EC50 <5 ~ "Low", Mean_EC50 <15 ~ "Medium", is.na(Mean_EC50) ~ "Unknown", TRUE ~ "High"))

  summary_table <- summary_table |> select(-Mean_EC50, -Publications) |> pivot_wider(names_from = "Drug", values_from = "Resistance") |> select(Gene, Mutation, Ganciclovir, Foscarnet, Cidofovir, Maribavir, Letermovir)


  tbl <- gt(summary_table)
  tbl <- tbl |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "grey"),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = Ganciclovir,
        rows = Ganciclovir == "Unknown"
      )
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "green"),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = Ganciclovir,
        rows = Ganciclovir == "Susceptible"
      )
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "yellow"),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = Ganciclovir,
        rows = Ganciclovir == "Low"
      )
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "orange"),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = Ganciclovir,
        rows = Ganciclovir == "Medium"
      )
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "red"),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = Ganciclovir,
        rows = Ganciclovir == "High"
      )
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "grey"),
```

# Detected Mutations Characterised in the Literature

```{r}
if(nrow(resis_df)==0){
  cat("No characterised resistance mutations were detected.")
} else {
  resis_df |> select(-CHROM) |> arrange(Gene, POS) |> gt() |> tab_spanner(
      label = "GCV",
      columns = c(Ganciclovir_EC50_ratio, ganciclovir_resistance)
    ) |> tab_spanner(
      label = "FOS",
      columns = c(Foscarnet_EC50_ratio, foscarnet_resistance)
    ) |> tab_spanner(
      label = "CDV",
      columns = c(Cidofovir_EC50_ratio, cidofovir_resistance)
    ) |> tab_spanner(
      label = "MBV",
      columns = c(Maribavir_EC50_ratio, maribavir_resistance)
    ) |> tab_spanner(
      label = "LET",
      columns = c(Letermovir_EC50_ratio, letermovir_resistance)
    ) |> tab_spanner(
      label = "Pulication",
      columns = c(TITLE, Authors, Published_Year, DOI)
    ) |> tab_spanner(
      label = "Variant Caller Details",
      columns = c(POS, REF, ALT, `DP[*]`, `AF[*]`, detected_by, n_callers)
    ) |> cols_label(
      Ganciclovir_EC50_ratio = html("EC50 ratio"),
      ganciclovir_resistance = html("Level"),
      Foscarnet_EC50_ratio = html("EC50 ratio"),
      foscarnet_resistance = html("Level"),
      Cidofovir_EC50_ratio = html("EC50 ratio"),
      cidofovir_resistance = html("Level"),
      Maribavir_EC50_ratio = html("EC50 ratio"),
      maribavir_resistance = html("Level"),
      Letermovir_EC50_ratio = html("EC50 ratio"),
      letermovir_resistance = html("Level"),
      `DP[*]` = html("Depth"),
      `AF[*]` = html("Frequency")
    ) |> tab_options(
    table.font.size = px(7)
  )
}



```

# AMR Gene Coverage

**AMR Gene coverage**

```{r}
#| fig-width: 16
#| fig-height: 10

cov <- coverage(readGAlignments(bam_file))
min_depth <- 40

muts <- read_tsv(bed_file, col_names = FALSE)
colnames(muts) <- c("Genome", "start", "end", "label")
mark_region <- muts

mark_region <- mark_region |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(
    depth = mean(
      as.numeric(
        cov[["NC_006273.2"]][start:end]
      )
    )
  ) |>
  ungroup()

mark_region$coverage_status <- ifelse(
  mark_region$depth >= min_depth,
  "Sufficient",
  "Insufficient"
)
ul27_mark <- mark_region |> filter(str_detect(label, "UL27"))
ul51_mark <- mark_region |> filter(str_detect(label, "UL51"))
ul54_mark <- mark_region |> filter(str_detect(label, "UL54"))
ul56_mark <- mark_region |> filter(str_detect(label, "UL56"))
ul89_mark <- mark_region |> filter(str_detect(label, "UL89"))
ul97_mark <- mark_region |> filter(str_detect(label, "UL97"))

track_df_ul27 <- LoadTrackFile(
  track.file = bam_file,
  format = "bam",
  single.nuc = TRUE,
  single.nuc.region = "NC_006273.2:33182-35008",
  bin.size = 1
)
track_df_ul27$Type <- "UL27"

track_df_ul51 <- LoadTrackFile(
  track.file = bam_file,
  format = "bam",
  single.nuc = TRUE,
  single.nuc.region = "NC_006273.2:74576-75049",
  bin.size = 1
)
track_df_ul51$Type <- "UL51"

track_df_ul54 <- LoadTrackFile(
  track.file = bam_file,
  format = "bam",
  single.nuc = TRUE,
  single.nuc.region = "NC_006273.2:78194-81922",
  bin.size = 1
)
track_df_ul54$Type <- "UL54"

track_df_ul56 <- LoadTrackFile(
  track.file = bam_file,
  format = "bam",
  single.nuc = TRUE,
  single.nuc.region = "NC_006273.2:84752-87304",
  bin.size = 1
)
track_df_ul56$Type <- "UL56"

track_df_ul89 <- LoadTrackFile(
  track.file = bam_file,
  format = "bam",
  single.nuc = TRUE,
  single.nuc.region = "NC_006273.2:133770-134906",
  bin.size = 1
)
track_df_ul89$Type <- "UL89_A"

track_df_ul97 <- LoadTrackFile(
  track.file = bam_file,
  format = "bam",
  single.nuc = TRUE,
  single.nuc.region = "NC_006273.2:141798-143921",
  bin.size = 1
)
track_df_ul97$Type <- "UL97"

if(max(track_df_ul27$score) < 40){
  height <- 40
} else {
  height <- max(track_df_ul27$score)
}
ul27 <- ggplot(track_df_ul27, aes(x = start, y = score)) +
  geom_area() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), panel.background = element_rect(fill = NA), axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.5), strip.background = element_rect(fill = "#94e4ca", colour = "black", linewidth = 0.5), strip.text = element_text(colour = "black", face = "bold")) +
  facet_grid(vars(Type)) +
  labs(x = "Position", y = "Depth") + 
  geom_rect(data = ul27_mark, inherit.aes = FALSE, aes(xmin = start, xmax = end, ymin = 0, ymax = Inf, fill = coverage_status)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(Sufficient = "grey", Insufficient = "red")) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, height))


if(max(track_df_ul51$score) < 40){
```

*As highlighted in the above figure, the following codons of known AMR mutations had insufficient coverage to be detected in this sample*

```{r}
insufficient <- mark_region |> filter(coverage_status == "Insufficient")

insufficient <- separate_wider_delim(insufficient, "label", delim = "_", names = c("Gene", "Mutation")) |> rowwise() |> mutate(codon = paste0(str_extract_all(Mutation, "\\d{1,4}"), collapse = "-")) |> select(Genome, Gene, codon, start, end, depth) |> arrange(codon)

insufficient |> gt()

```

# Mutations of Unknown Significance

*The below mutations were identified but are of unknown significance*

```{r}
all_muts <- read_tsv(all_muts_file)
if(nrow(all_muts)==0){
  cat("No variants of unknown significance were detected.")
} else {
  genes <- c("UL27", "UL51", "UL54", "UL56", "UL89", "UL97")
  all_muts <- all_muts |> filter(`ANN[*].GENE` %in% genes) |> arrange(factor(`ANN[*].GENE`, levels=genes), POS) |> filter(!AA_change %in% resis_df$Mutation) |> select(-sampleID)#this could filter out mutations in the wrong gene... will need to fix
  all_muts |> gt()
}



```
